terms.comment: Our use: Traupman, Morgan–Owens and Levi–Bini have no word for a child’s building blocks. Classically cubus is a cube or a die (Vitr. 5 praef. 4, in Lewis & Short).

sources: Lewis & Short: cubus · Lewis & Short: laterculus
